about_the_game:
The demo will include half of the main story, full voice acting for all characters’ interjections, and rich world exploration and dialogues, but will not feature card battles.

The PvE card combat system has turned out to involve far more design factors than we initially expected! We’re working hard to craft battles that are genuinely fun and expressive of each character’s abilities and personality, rather than just simple numerical clashes.

The final release will not only present the complete second half of the story, but also further enhance the map atmosphere and sound design, add more visual elements to world exploration, deliver the full card-battle gameplay, and enrich character development—allowing players to uncover the secrets and growth of each character as the story unfolds.
